Microsoft Imposes Time Limits on Xbox Cloud Gaming

Microsoft is introducing monthly time limits for Xbox Cloud Gaming subscribers as part of broader changes to its Game Pass service. The company stated these limits are a response to rising cloud gaming costs, which will allow for further investment in performance. Existing and new Game Pass subscribers will be subject to these new restrictions. Additionally, Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go option for Xbox Cloud Gaming.
